environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 with default namespace. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with hostPath volume mount to /var/run/postgresql socket. PostgreSQL 15 instance on the host with the service account having db_owner role. No network policies applied. Container image runs with privileged: true securityContext. The DATABASE_URL connects via Unix socket with superuser credentials stored in a ConfigMap.
